international.title: Trump downplays US outages and Nvidia security concerns in remarks before China summit – live
international.summary: Asked by Fox News about China’s alleged spying operation, president says: ‘We spy on them too. I think we spy better than they do’ Sign up for US breaking News email Linked to that, the White House held a briefing call with several reporters today about the wave of tech outages affecting several industries. CNN reported that officials said the administration underscored that what has happened is not as a result of cyber-attacks but due to the “hardening and upgrading of our systems ”, including “systems being patched, hardware being applied” . Per CNN, an official added: “It’s good the American people are focused on the need to upgrade our legacy systems.” Continue reading...
